subject: In Alzheimer's models, obesity-related fats reached the brain and raised amyloid
script: From Agewell Brief: In Alzheimer's models, obesity-related fats reached the brain and raised amyloid. New research in Alzheimer's models suggests obesity-related fats can reach the brain, disrupt immune defenses, and boost amyloid buildup. Correcting the imbalance improved memory. Obesity may raise brain levels of certain fat molecules. These fats can disrupt the brain's immune defenses. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
